verdicts.reason: A has a clean, well-structured card: the headline is dominant and the CTA stands clear on the right. However, it drops the book-cover hero image entirely and shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo until it can't be read, and the fine print is tiny. B keeps the book, but it loses the card. Its logo, kicker, body copy and fine print all sit directly on busy confetti and are hard to read, a stray partial panel sits behind the headline, and the elements are scattered with no clear grid.
